title: nbn service disruption - Howlong, NSW
current_summary:
Services in Howlong, NSW were affected from about 11:43 am AEDT on 1 November 2026 and were restored at about 4:05 pm AEDT the same day.

A local power outage is affecting the nbn network, resulting in service interruptions for customers. nbn is actively monitoring the situation, and once power returns, will check alarms and run network health checks to ensure stability. For details such as the Estimated Time to Restore (ETR), please reach out to your local power provider. After power is restored, nbn suggests resetting your modem and in-home devices if you continue to have issues.

Resolution: Power has been restored to nbn network equipment

Services in your area have been restored following an unexpected network issue. If your service has not reconnected automatically, try restarting your Wi-Fi router and nbn Connection Box (if you have one).
